label: Local and uniform individual makers: LocalMaker means at each accessible world some bearer makes…
definition: LocalMaker means at each accessible world some bearer makes the SAME fact true; the bearer may change. UniformMaker means one SAME bearer makes that fact true at every accessible world. With WorldImmanent and actual self-access the latter gives an actual necessary individual. A necessary fact, and even a necessary individual, does not itself supply this making relation.
note: Stipulative quantifier distinction. Alternating model is local without uniformity; fixedBearer supports uniform making; switchingFixedMaking retains a necessary individual but switches makers of the existential fact. Necessitation of the truth by a maker is distinct from necessity of the maker.
